title: 第21章 白书墨第22章 计划进行中
content_zh:
“哈哈哈！你逃不掉的乖乖做本少爷的灵宠不好吗？”一名身穿华贵衣服的少年，右脚踩在蛟龙头上右小臂放在膝盖上附身对着蛟龙戏谑的说道。
“吼！”蛟龙不甘的低吼，它现在的身躯被两名黑衣男子手持锁链控制住。
“呦，还不服气啊！给我加大力气让这条蛟龙感受一下痛苦！”白书墨对着蛟龙吐了口唾沫随后取出一把椅子坐在蛟龙硕大的龙头面前看着蛟龙。
“是！少爷！”两名黑衣男子听到自己少爷的命令加大了锁链的力道，蛟龙在铁链的收缩下开始痛苦低吼。
此时杨修和郑元雪也来到了近前，看到地上的蛟龙正是昨天晚上跑路的小蛟龙，杨修刚想出手却被郑元雪阻止了，杨修一脸疑惑的看着郑元雪。
郑元雪见杨修看向自己手指白书墨说道“你知道那人是谁吗？”
杨修顺着郑元雪手指的方向看到了白书墨看到了他华丽的衣着随后开口“他是谁啊？”
郑元雪没有卖关子直接说道“现任白家家主四子白书墨！”
杨修听到郑元雪的话双手握紧语气带着冷意的说“白家？白将军府？”
郑元雪点点头随后拍拍杨修肩头开口“是那个白家，但是你先别着急听我把话说完！”
杨修本来想立刻动手但是听到郑元雪的话压下了火气冷哼一句“他今天必死！”
郑元雪暗暗松了口气说“没有不让你杀他，我只是怕你冲动你没看到压制蛟龙那两人的实力吗？”
杨修感知两名黑衣人修为一下，发现自己居然看不破两人的实力，才发现自己刚刚如果动手很大可能杀不了白书墨还会将自己的性命送上。
郑元雪看到杨修的表情便已经知道杨修冷静下来了随后开口道“在大乾王都这白将军府白书墨之名已经被人唾弃了，据传他五年前因为当街撞死一名身怀六甲之人，被我父皇判死罪，现如今看来应该是白樊狸猫换太子将他救了出来。”
“白府之前就已经如此目无王法了嘛？”杨修听到郑元雪的话刚刚被压下的火气又再次点燃了。
郑元雪叹了口气开口“所有事情只要瞒过父皇和世人，重新赋予有罪之人新的身份，一切都可以重新开始，有的时候即便父皇知道之人没死也没办法！毕竟在众人眼里这个人已经死了！”
杨修双手再次握紧，郑元雪见状说“那两个黑衣人如果我所猜不错的话应该是早些年就追随白书墨的刘江和刘河两兄弟，五年前这两人实力就已经是问道二阶一重，现如今不知到了何种境界！”
杨修听到郑元雪的话眉头微微皱了起来小声问道“那要怎么办？”
郑元雪对着杨修微微一笑随后开口“这白书墨除了在王都做的那件事出名之外还有另一个出名的性格！”
杨修淡淡开口问“什么性格？”

“好色，据说他曾经因为想和醉月楼头牌见一面扬言要烧了醉月楼，后来所传其他的事情也都是他看上谁家的小姐想霸王硬上弓之类的传闻！所以我有一个计划！”郑元雪一脸神秘道。
杨修的好奇心被勾起来了问道“什么计划？”
郑元雪挥手从储物戒子中拿出一套衣服和一个小瓶子开口道“这身衣服是之前我偷偷跑出宫时穿的衣服，这个小瓶子里面是两年前宫里调制的一种特有香料，这香料有一个特点就是修士长时间吸入再加上食用肉类的话会极大程度扰乱灵气运转，起到压制修为的作用！”
杨修一脸惊讶的看着郑元雪开口“你怎么什么都有？”
“哼哼！本公主好东西多着呢！你转过身去等着！”郑元雪一脸得意的说，然后她让杨修转过身便开始换起了衣服。
content_en:
"Hahaha! If you can't escape, why don't you obediently become my young master's spiritual pet?" A young man wearing luxurious clothes stepped on the dragon's head with his right foot and put his right forearm on his knees and said to the dragon jokingly.
"Roar!" The dragon roared unwillingly. Its body was now controlled by two men in black holding chains.
"Hey, you are still not convinced! Give me more strength to make this dragon feel the pain!" Bai Shumo spat at the dragon, then took out a chair and sat in front of the dragon's huge head and looked at the dragon.
"Yes! Master!" The two men in black heard their master's order and increased the strength of the chains. The dragon began to roar in pain under the contraction of the chains.
At this time, Yang Xiu and Zheng Yuanxue also came closer and saw that the dragon on the ground was the little dragon that ran away last night. Yang Xiu just wanted to take action but was stopped by Zheng Yuanxue. Yang Xiu looked at Zheng Yuanxue with a puzzled face.
Zheng Yuanxue saw Yang Xiu looking at Bai Shumo and saying, "Do you know who that person is?"
Yang Xiu followed the direction of Zheng Yuanxue's finger and saw Bai Shumo. He saw his gorgeous clothes and said, "Who is he?"
Zheng Yuanxue said directly without giving in, "Bai Shumo, the fourth son of the current head of the Bai family!"
When Yang Xiu heard Zheng Yuanxue's words, he clenched his hands and said with a cold tone, "Bai family? General Bai's mansion?"
Zheng Yuanxue nodded and then patted Yang Xiu on the shoulder and said, "It's the Bai family, but don't worry, just listen to what I have to say!"
Yang Xiu originally wanted to take action immediately, but when he heard Zheng Yuanxue's words, he suppressed his anger and snorted, "He will die today!"
Zheng Yuanxue secretly breathed a sigh of relief and said, "I didn't stop you from killing him. I was just afraid that you would be impulsive. Didn't you see the strength of the two people who suppressed Jiaolong?"
Yang Xiu sensed the cultivation level of the two men in black and found that he could not see through their strength. Only then did he realize that if he had taken action just now, he would probably not be able to kill Bai Shumo and would also end up taking his own life.
Seeing Yang Xiu's expression, Zheng Yuanxue knew that Yang Xiu had calmed down and then said, "In the capital of Daqian, the name of Bai Shumo has been despised by people in General Bai's Mansion. It is said that he was sentenced to death by my father for hitting and killing a pregnant woman in the street five years ago. Now it seems that Bai Fan was rescued by the civet cat for the prince."
"Has the Bai Mansion been so lawless before?" Yang Xiu's anger that had just been suppressed was reignited when he heard Zheng Yuanxue's words.
Zheng Yuanxue sighed and said, "As long as everything is hidden from my father and the world, and the guilty person is given a new identity, everything can start again. Sometimes, even if the person my father knows is not dead, there is nothing we can do! After all, in the eyes of everyone, this person is already dead!"
Yang Xiu clenched his hands again. Seeing this, Zheng Yuanxue said, "If my guess is correct, those two men in black should be the two brothers Liu Jiang and Liu He who followed Bai Shumo many years ago. Five years ago, the strength of these two people was already at the second level and first level. I don't know what level they have reached now!"
Yang Xiu frowned slightly when he heard Zheng Yuanxue's words and asked softly, "What should we do?"
Zheng Yuanxue smiled slightly at Yang Xiu and then said, "In addition to being famous for what he did in the royal capital, Bai Shumo has another famous character!"
Yang Xiu asked calmly, "What's your personality?"
"Luxury, it is said that he once threatened to burn down Zuiyue Tower because he wanted to meet the top boss of Zuiyue Tower. Later, other rumors were also about rumors that he had a crush on some girl and wanted to dominate her! So I have a plan!" Zheng Yuanxue said with a mysterious face.
Yang Xiu's curiosity was aroused and he asked, "What's the plan?"
Zheng Yuanxue waved her hand and took out a set of clothes and a small bottle from the storage ring and said, "These clothes are the ones I wore when I sneaked out of the palace. Inside this small bottle is a special spice prepared in the palace two years ago. One of the characteristics of this spice is that if monks inhale it for a long time and eat meat, it will greatly disrupt their spiritual luck.Turn, it plays the role of suppressing cultivation! "
Yang Xiu looked at Zheng Yuanxue in surprise and said, "Why do you have everything?" "
"Hmph! This princess has a lot of good things! You turn around and wait! Zheng Yuanxue said with a proud face, then she asked Yang Xiu to turn around and started to change clothes.
